Description: Automate: welcome, onboarding, re-engagement, churn prevention, payment failed sequences. Trigger-based not time-based.
Automate_When: After defining customer lifecycle stages|After first 20 manual emails prove the sequence works
Keep_Manual: First email to high-value prospects|Personal win-back for top accounts

Description: Batch-create content weekly, schedule across platforms. Maintain consistent posting without daily effort.
Automate_When: After finding content format that resonates (test manually first)|When posting >3x/week

Description: Automate: recurring billing, invoice generation, payment receipts, tax calculation, failed payment dunning.
Automate_When: From first paying customer|No reason to do this manually
Keep_Manual: Annual contract negotiations|Custom enterprise pricing|Refund decisions

Description: Auto-respond to common questions using knowledge base. Route complex issues to human. Track: self-service resolution rate.
Automate_When: After documenting top 20 support questions|When support volume >20 tickets/week
Keep_Manual: Angry customer escalations|Bug reports|Account issues|Billing disputes

Description: Automate: test on PR, build on merge, deploy on main. Zero manual deployment. Include: lint, test, type-check, deploy.
Automate_When: From first production deployment|Before adding second engineer

Description: Auto-detect errors, downtime, performance degradation. Alert via Slack/email. Auto-escalate if not acknowledged in 15 minutes.
Automate_When: After first production user|When uptime matters (always)
Keep_Manual: Root cause analysis|Incident response decisions|Post-mortem documentation

Description: Auto-trigger in-app surveys: NPS monthly, feature satisfaction after use, churn reason on cancel. Route to product backlog.
Automate_When: After first 50 active users|When you can act on feedback
Keep_Manual: Customer interviews (keep manual)|Feedback on major features|Founder-led discovery calls

Description: Auto-generate: weekly metrics email, MRR dashboard, churn report, feature adoption. Stakeholders get data without asking.
Automate_When: After defining 5-10 key metrics|When reviewing metrics weekly

Description: When scaling past 5 people: automate team onboarding, vendor workflows, SOPs enforcement, compliance checks. Build an automation playbook documenting what to automate vs keep manual at each growth stage.
Automate_When: After team > 5 people|When same process is done > 10x/month|When errors in manual process are costly
Keep_Manual: Strategic decisions|Hiring final calls|Customer escalations|Culture and values enforcement
